thread:
carla_sales: Quick sync for Meridian Bank POC. Requirements: SAML (SP+IdP), SCIM 2.0 with delta + one-time bulk import, Okta group->role mapping (they use nested groups), delegated admin for HR, domain proofing across 3 subdomains. Procurement needs a 2-line buyer blurb, a short security line, and a predictable monthly pricing model.

evan_ps: Product note: SCIM 2.0 delta + bulk import supported. Hosted default SCIM limit 150req/s (token smoothing). Dedicated can reserve throughput and workers for deterministic provisioning latency. For onboarding spikes we recommend Dedicated or a time-limited provisioning quota add-on.

sana_se: Nested groups: default behavior is to flatten membership to a single set for RBAC. If they require ancestry we can include ancestry metadata via includeNested flag; advise they send a sample Okta export to validate cycles/size.

carla_sales: They want to confirm we never store passwords or national IDs.

mike_security: Confirmed: we do not store plaintext passwords or national identifiers. SCIM attributes (email, externalId, groups, optional attrs) encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) and in transit (TLS1.2+). For Dedicated/Private we support customer-managed KMS/HSM and full provisioning audit logs. Optional PII fields can be redacted on request.

ivy_pricing: Pricing model: base provisioning tier covers up to a band of active users + per-active-user bands. Ramps can be covered with a temporary reserved-throughput fee or Dedicated commitment. For ~18k users they likely fall in 10k-25k band; include a 2-3 week ramp add-on for predictable monthly. I'll fetch exact numbers.

carla_sales: Two-line buyer blurb I can paste?

sana_se: "Redwood supports SAML 2.0 (SP/IdP), SCIM 2.0 with bulk import and delta sync, and IdP group-to-role mappings. For predictable large onboardings we recommend Redwood Dedicated (reserved provisioning throughput) or Hosted with a provisioning quota add-on; we do not store plaintext passwords or national IDs and support customer-managed KMS for higher compliance."

evan_ps: Small YAML snippet for SOW to paste:

```
provisioning:
  protocol: "SCIM 2.0"
  bulk_import: true
  delta_sync: true
  unique_key: "externalId | userName"
  group_mapping: "idp.group -> app.role (flattened by default)"
  hosted_default_rate: "150req/s"
  dedicated: "reserved concurrency + SLA option"
```

carla_sales: Ops asks before I send: sample SCIM export, ramp dates (UTC), webhook endpoint or proxy, and DNS admin contact for TXT verification. Mike: please start the vendor questionnaire and flag any blockers.

mike_security: On it. Main potential blocker: if they require on-prem-only HSM with air-gapped key exchange -> moves to Private deployment and needs infra planning. Otherwise first pass in 24h. :thumbsup:
